name: Mihagino Ayano
source: Third-year high school student. At the beginning of the story, she is saved by [url=/c10457]Haruto[/url] during a car accident, and because of that, she goes full deredere mode on him afterwards. In order to repay Haruto, she looked after him during his hospitalization. Because she is a sheltered girl, she doesn't understand much about relationships with boys, and is bad at communicating with them. After Haruto gets discharged from the hospital, she moves in with him as his caretaker.
